IACUC 8528. Three consecutive daily fractions totaling 6 Gy to the entire GI tract under anesthesia, with stool sampling and rechecks at 1 week, 1, 3 and 6 months. Named investigator Tiffany Martin, DVM. Distinct from Texas A&M 358215 (different center, eligibility and fractionation), Missouri high-grade GI lymphoma WART+COP/doxorubicin, and Tufts inflammatory-enteropathy RT (excludes GI lymphoma). Official native state Active - Recruiting; individual rendered protocol accepts screening, states recruitment from 2026-11-02. One named site CSU VHEC, 300 W Drake Rd, Fort Collins, Colorado. Feline small-cell GI lymphoma confirmed by endoscopic biopsy. Signs for at least six weeks (overview says more than six; leave exact boundary for coordinator). No previous chemotherapy. Recently changed diet, antibiotics or steroids may be eligible after waiting periods not specified. Adequate condition for anesthesia/radiation. Before enrollment CBC/chemistry, urinalysis, cobalamin/folate, abdominal ultrasound, thoracic radiographs, IHC and PARR within protocol-specific times. After enrollment the study covers radiation, stool testing and protocol recheck appointments. Owners pay other diagnostic and treatment-related costs; do not infer separate anesthesia or travel coverage. CSU Oncology Clinical Trials, csuoncologytrials@colostate.edu; (970) 297-4001. Current individual page states recruitment begins 2026-11-02; no end date is published. Six-month follow-up is relative to treatment and not an enrollment cutoff.
